description: The virtual dispatch queries pass step 1: virtual-dispatch call sites across the full decomped surface (receiver slot1, receiver workers, N-API impls, N-API callees). For each `(**(code **)(*<var> + 0xN))(...)` and the single-star variant, pair the slot offset with the cast class identified by an upstream `FUN_009da6cc(... <Class>::RTTI ...)` assignment. Indirect-via-param calls are catalogued separately for follow-up (class context isn't statically recoverable from the decomp alone).
